findings: softInsertion is the actual Fin.insertNth tuple in increasing physical order, with old entries read through boundaryIndex 0 and inserted value P j + epsilon*q. Its old/new evaluation theorems use the exact inverse label-position maps and insertNth elimination laws. Since every enlarged index is new or uniquely old, these identities describe the whole tuple.

The formula is defined for every real parameter; the source family is its restriction to positive epsilon. The extension through zero is appropriate for later limiting arguments and does not assert genericity there. Continuity is proved coordinatewise by the exhaustive index partition: every old coordinate is constant, and the single new coordinate is affine.

The three edge formulas derive from actual cyclic successor identities: every mapped old edge k!=j equals its original direction; the edge starting at mapped old j is epsilon*q; the edge starting at the new index is edge P j minus epsilon*q. Thus the return ends at the old successor of j and the physical wrap is included. These are actual vector equalities for all labels, not only endpoint descriptions.

SoftAdmissible is exactly the source conjunction: nonzero det(incoming,q), nonzero det(q,outgoing), and nonzero det(q,P k-P j) for every other old label. The separate vector_ne_zero proof derives q!=0 from the outgoing determinant; it is not an extra assumption or an admissibility substitute.
